title: ArchiveMe conclusion evaluation record
description: One evaluation case for the auditable conclusion pipeline. A fixture file is an object with a `cases` array of these records. Fixture content is SYNTHETIC ONLY: no real user journal text may ever be placed in this directory.

caseId.description: Stable unique identifier for the case.

entryB.description: The later saved moment, or null for single-moment (observation) cases.

relatedExpected.description: Whether a careful human reader would say the two moments are about the same subject or thread. This is a semantic judgement, NOT a prediction of what the engine does: a pair can be genuinely related and still be correctly refused a conclusion. For single-moment cases this is false and the case is excluded from related-pair metrics.

expectedKind.description: The strongest reading the evidence honestly supports. `neither` means no conclusion of any kind should be produced.

expectedChangedDimensions.description: Dimensions that a careful human reader would say actually moved, as `dimension:direction` pairs. Empty for repeat, observation and neither cases.

supportedConclusion.description: A statement the cited evidence genuinely supports, or null when nothing should be concluded. The harness probes this through the real semantic gate and expects it to be accepted (except where `expectedSuppressionReason` says otherwise).

prohibitedConclusions.description: Statements the evidence must never support. Every one of these is probed through the real semantic gate and must be rejected.

expectedSuppressionReason.description: The SemanticConclusionRejection the gate should raise when this case must produce nothing, or null when a conclusion is expected.

sourceDomain.description: Life area the synthetic language belongs to. `health` never contains diagnosis language.

humanLabelStatus.description: Provenance of the expectations on this record. Everything under fixtures/ is `unlabelled`: the expectations are author-written synthetic intent, not human-validated ground truth.

transcript.description: SYNTHETIC transcript text. Never real user content.

threadId.description: Explicit archive thread assignment, when the case tests thread-only alignment.

captureContextTag.description: Explicit capture context tag, when the case tests tag-only alignment.

runtime.description: Case-level runtime conditions carried on the entry they apply to.

deleted.description: The saved moment has been deleted by the user.

modelGenerated.description: The text is model-generated and must never be cited as the user's own words.

framingCorrectedByUser.description: The user previously said this framing was the wrong angle.
